title: A triple glued with signs from two integer multiplicity triples is an integer multiplicity triple
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U C : Set (Euclid P)) (R₁ R₂ : IMRep U n) (θ : Euclid P → ℕ) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P n), MeasurableSet C → C ⊆ R₁.carrier ∪ R₂.carrier → Measurable θ → (∀ x ∈ C, 0 < θ x) → (∀ x ∈ C, θ x ≤ R₁.carrier.indicator R₁.mult x + R₂.carrier.indicator R₂.mult x) → AEStronglyMeasurable ξ (μHE[n].restrict C) → (∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict (C ∩ R₁.carrier)), ξ x = R₁.orient x ∨ ξ x = -R₁.orient x) → (∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict (C \ R₁.carrier)), ξ x = R₂.orient x ∨ ξ x = -R₂.orient x) → (∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict (C ∩ R₁.carrier)), ∀ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n R₁.carrier x Q → HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n C x Q) → (∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict (C \ R₁.carrier)), ∀ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n R₂.carrier x Q → HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n C x Q) → ∃ R : IMRep U n, R.carrier = C ∧ R.mult = θ ∧ R.orient = ξ
